why: Steininger & Yurkevich (arXiv 2508.18475, Aug 2025) construct the 'Noperthedron', an explicit convex polyhedron proved (via computer search over 18 million cases plus analytic bounds) to lack Rupert's property, disproving the conjecture that every convex polyhedron is Rupert.
